One cohesive task makes the mechanized review surface active-only: the global `MustExist` scan discovers active plans before reading any plan content and drops the `review.historical-path-absent` notice and guide; scoped review stops calling `readAmendmentInstrument` and reports the existing `amendmentCountAudit` not-run absence with a current-only policy reason and matching absence; and the two selected-review location predicates classify archive phase by the project-relative bundle path. The product scope is exactly `src/review/core.ts`, `src/review/catalog.ts`, `src/review/core.test.ts` (M-REVIEW) and `src/verification/localize.test.ts` (M-LOCALIZE); both modules and their `V-M-*` anchors are covered. The three ordinary criteria (`AC-AMENDMENT-AUDIT-ABSENCE`, `AC-SELECTED-PHASE-PREDICATES`, `AC-CATALOG-POPULATION`) are mapped through `Satisfies`; `AC-ACTIVE-ONLY-DISCOVERY`, `AC-ARCHIVE-PRESERVATION` and `AC-BOUNDED-WRITES` are close-bound and are implementation obligations of the task, never `Satisfies` targets, and their CloseEvidence commands are not duplicated here. The preservation base stays `61a9e42e3d06a63f1a863cb01e019f499c862a60`. No helper file or export, no grammar/gates/query/status/skill/footprint/README change, and no record conversion is planned. The sanctioned close performs its ordinary own-bundle lifecycle writes: `ngrace gate verdict` persists the Verdict and its `CloseEvidence` children in the bundle's `run-ledger.xml`; `ngrace apply` writes `applied` status onto the bundle's `spec.xml` and `plan.xml`, writes the applied Decisions and fingerprints into `run-ledger.xml`, and then renames the bundle directory; the cursor, attempt, and fold commands own the bundle's `run.xml`, `run/**`, and ledger epoch state. Local final evidence is the Linux workflow's `bun run validate:ci` plus the required `bun run validate:cli` plus `bun run release:check`; the Windows compatibility job and the Dart-adapter job in `.github/workflows/validate.yml` are not executed locally and are not claimed. The full CI-equivalent verification is close-time only, at the `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` under `--assertions final --run-commands`, and is exempt from PLAN command driving; the root current-mode lint is pre-write only. The approved SPEC overrides `ngrace-plan` rule 19's conflicting full-CI-at-PLAN teaching; that teaching repair belongs to the third authorized slice.

T-001.Title: Make the mechanized review surface active-only and archive-honest

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red-first evidence before the runtime change, captured on a disposable project copy and recorded with the command output: (i) a review read-spy driven over a fresh unique synthetic project with a cold predecessor cache records calls under `.ngrace/changes/archive/` from the global `MustExist` scan; (ii) scoped review reports `Amendment count: re-ratifications=0 supersede-depth=1` (status `ran`) for the selected bundle; (iii) `allReviewCodes()` still contains `review.historical-path-absent` and the literal length pins still hold. Capture each red before the corresponding repair.

In `src/review/core.ts`, the global `MustExist` scan (`detectConfidentlyWrong`, current `core.ts:472-574`, plan loop from the `listFilesRecursive(root, changes)` call and the archived branch at `core.ts:544-566`) discovers active `plan.xml` files before reading any plan content and opens no unrelated archived plan; the `review.historical-path-absent` producer and its archive branch are removed. Active `BaselineAssertions` and `TargetAssertions` absent-path errors are preserved, including undeclared/unexempt target claims, the declared-future target exemption, and the shared identity helpers (`scopeIdentityFromPlanRel`, `expandScopePathsForArchiveIdentity`). A deliberately selected archive record stays readable by its own selected consumer.

Read-boundary proof: a `bun:test` call-through spy over the real exported `readGraceXmlArtifact` records each call's `file` and calls through to the original. Over a fresh unique synthetic project with a cold predecessor cache, carrying at least one active plan and at least one archived plan, plus a neutral and a misleading parent `changes/archive` root, driving the real `runPatternDetectors`, unscoped `runReview`, and selected-active `runReview` records zero calls whose path is under `.ngrace/changes/archive/` and a non-empty set of active-plan calls as the positive control; the spy and any mutated synthetic inputs are restored after each case.

Behaviour on the active refusal counterweight: an active plan with an absent baseline target and an absent undeclared target each still emit `review.confidently-wrong` / `must-exist-missing` at error; declaring the target under `ObservedWriteScope` and creating the baseline removes the two errors; exact restoration restores the identical findings.

In `src/review/core.ts`, `runReview` stops calling `readAmendmentInstrument` (current call at `core.ts:1811`, import at `core.ts:82`; remove the import if it becomes unused) and reports the existing `amendmentCountAudit` with `status="not-run"`, a non-empty reason naming the current-only policy that archive-dependent amendment measurement is not a current review input, and a matching non-empty absence record; the report carries no `reRatificationCount` and no `supersedeChainDepth` key, no fabricated zero, and no `ran`. Unscoped review keeps its existing `not-run` reason naming the missing `--change`. No ledger API and no duplicate counting algorithm is added; the formatter's not-run branch is reused.

In `src/review/core.ts`, the two selected-review location predicates (`isAbandonedArchiveBundle`, current `core.ts:1488-1494`, and `auditCloseEvidenceUnevaluated`, current `core.ts:1899-1918`) classify archive phase from the actual project-relative bundle path rather than from an absolute-path substring containing a `changes/archive` marker. A private expression or function inside this file is allowed; no new helper file or export and no `src/grace-cursor.ts` change. Each classifier carries its own discriminating test, separate from the global reader spy, and those tests are driven at info severity (the API's info level), because `review.attempt-pair-unpaired-pass` is hidden by the default warning threshold: (i) an active rejected spec plus a pass-only attempt emits `review.attempt-pair-unpaired-pass` in a neutral parent root but the pre-fix classifier suppresses it when the same project sits under a misleading parent root whose path contains `changes/archive`; (ii) an active applied spec and plan with unevaluated `CloseEvidence` gains erroneous close-evidence findings only under the misleading parent root. After repair the same active location behaves consistently across both roots, comparing the intended phase codes rather than incidental historical notices. Genuine archive-phase controls are retained under either parent: an applied record reports its unevaluated close criteria under either parent, and an abandoned record excludes the pass-only attempt under either parent. Exact bytes, events, and directories are restored after each case. These deliberately invalid active statuses are refused by current lint; the tests isolate the review-route phase handling and that limitation is disclosed. Hand-placed synthetic archive controls are not actual apply/archive lifecycle evidence. Fixture shape follows current source, schema, and API definitions, not historical ledger-corpus searches.

In `src/review/catalog.ts`, the `review.historical-path-absent` guide (current `catalog.ts:338-352`) is removed from `REVIEW_CATALOG`, `allReviewCodes()`, and the explain surface. In `src/review/core.test.ts` and `src/verification/localize.test.ts`, every corresponding case, literal length pin and stale explanatory comment or title is retired or reframed — including the historical tests around `core.test.ts:1507-1608,3970,4467-4480,4872-4893`, the length pins at `core.test.ts:2478,3116,3122,4887` and `localize.test.ts:433,439`, and the scoped amendment test at `core.test.ts:4359-4365` — while the D8 admissible set stays exactly the three named codes, the family-A pattern set stays exactly the five named codes, and the whole-population catalog/localization exclusive-or coverage holds, measured through the real exported catalog/localization functions including `allReviewCodes()`, not a projected count.

Scope and lifecycle: the change writes only the four product paths. The sanctioned close performs the ordinary own-bundle lifecycle writes as described in `IntentSummary`: `ngrace apply` writes `applied` status onto the bundle's `spec.xml` and `plan.xml`, writes the applied Decisions and fingerprints into `run-ledger.xml`, and then renames the bundle directory; cursor, attempt, and fold own `run.xml`, `run/**`, and ledger epoch state. These are the CLI's own-bundle effects, excluded by the scope audit's own-bundle identity and CLI-lifecycle rules, and are not re-listed in `ObservedWriteScope` or as persistent lock exceptions. No new helper file or export, and no grammar, gates, query, status, skill, footprint, README, or examples change.

Verification feasibility: the unchanged narrow task Verification command (`bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts src/verification/localize.test.ts`) carries its prior identity evidence. Newly introduced narrow commands and every structural `BaselineAssertions` / `TargetAssertions` assertion are driven on a disposable approved-shaped copy: baseline must be green, and target pre-implementation reds are recorded honestly. No unevaluated command is claimed to have passed. The root current-mode lint is not run after writes and is never a task or target command. No full suite or full CI runs at PLAN.
